Build a new plugin-authored component, `.pfx-button-set`, in
`plugins/pantoken/custom-components` (NOT a modification of `formats/components`'s button.css).
It wraps `.pfx-button` children with zero gap and squared interior corners (always seamed — that
is the component's whole purpose), and its own chained modifiers (`-color-*`, `-size-*`,
`-shape-*`, `-toggle`, `-condensed`, `-without-background`, `-without-border`, `-on-color`,
`-display-block`) act as **defaults** for every child button that doesn't carry its own modifier
in that same category — a child's own modifier class always wins.

**Decisions (confirmed with user, superseding the earlier plan)**
- New, distinct class name: `.pfx-button-set` (not a modifier/extension of core's existing
  `.pfx-button-group` wrapper — avoids any selector-ownership collision between packages).
- Always seamed: no separate opt-in modifier for the flush/no-gap/no-interior-radius layout.
- Cascadable modifier scope: **all** existing button modifiers (not just the curated subset) —
  every `-color-*` (including `-color-ai`, `-color-ai-secondary`, `-on-color` combos), `-size-*`,
  `-shape-*`, `-toggle`, `-condensed`, `-without-background`, `-without-border`, `-display-block`.
- `-icon-*` stays per-button only — never settable/cascaded from the group.
- Technique: **selector-list duplication with an ancestor + `:not()` exclusion guard**, e.g.
  `.pfx-button-set.-color-secondary > .pfx-button:not([class*="-color-"])`, repeated for every
  state variant (rest/`:hover`/`:active`/`:disabled`/`[aria-disabled="true"]`) that the source
  modifier has in button.css. This exact pattern (ancestor class + `:not([class*="-color-"])`
  exclusion on `.pfx-button` descendants) is already established, working precedent in this same
  plugin package — see `banner.css`'s button-group action-button styling
  (`> .button-group > .pfx-button:not(:has(+ .pfx-button)):not([class*="-color-"])` etc., around
  [banner.css](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/banner/banner.css#L230-L293)).
- No custom-property refactor of button.css — button.css stays untouched; all cascading logic and
  duplicated declarations live entirely in the new plugin file, referencing the same
  `var(--instui-...)` tokens button.css uses (single source of truth stays the *token values*,
  even though the *selectors* are necessarily duplicated — there is no plain-CSS mechanism to avoid
  this once children must be able to override per-category).

**Known tradeoff / risk**
- This duplicates a large fraction of button.css's modifier declarations (a rough estimate: ~40
  rule blocks across color/size/shape/toggle/condensed/without-*, each needing an ancestor+`:not()`
  twin for every state it has). Two source-of-truth CSS blocks means a future button.css visual
  change (e.g. a new hover token) will not automatically propagate to `button-set`'s cascaded

- Icon plugin registration: [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts#L1)

- **Likely causes:** (a) Glyph name mismatch: If a component uses `instui-icon -icon-{name}` but that icon's token isn't in the IR (missing from `@pantoken/tokens` or one of the plugin manifests), the picker won't list it. (b) CDN fetch failure: For simple-icons & lucide-lab, glyphs are loaded from CDN sheets. If `buildFileUrl()` in [packages/cdn/src/build-url.ts](packages/cdn/src/build-url.ts) returns a 404 URL or network times out, the glyphs render as blank. - Grid sizing: [icon-picker-styles.ts line 112](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L112): `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(40px, 1fr))` — each tile is minimum 40px
- Icon glyph size: [icon-picker-styles.ts line 123](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L123): `font-size: 20px;` on the tile itself
- **Diagnosis:** Icon tiles may appear large because the min-width is 40px (relatively large grid cell). If the container is narrow, fewer columns fit and tiles become larger. Also, Simple Icons use only `viewBox` (no explicit `width`/`height`), so they fall back to browser's default replaced-element size until CSS constrains them — [icon-picker-styles.ts lines 26–29](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L26-L29) addresses this in the autocompleter row.

### 2. **ICON PICKER HIGHLIGHT CONTRAST**

**Selected/highlighted state CSS:**
- File: [renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L138-L157)
- Selected background: `background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent);` ([line 139](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L139))

**Light vs dark mode contrast issue:**
- **Root cause:** The picker uses `CanvasText` (CSS system color, [line 73](renderers/tinymce/src/lib/icon-picker-styles.ts#L73)) for text color and `currentColor` for borders/backgrounds. In light mode, `CanvasText` is dark (high contrast on light background). In dark mode, `CanvasText` is light (should contrast on dark), BUT the `color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent)` background becomes light (18% of light color + 82% transparent = very pale), and a light icon on pale background fails WCAG contrast.

**"-on-color" convention elsewhere:**
